contracts.production_boundary: No production file is changed by this task; the production port and composition remain owned by OPGAP-BE-PERSONA-RECONCILIATION-MUTATION-PORT-20260830.

composition_verification.reason: This task is correctly rooted at dev and owns no production change. The declared port is pending in the sibling delivery, so verification used an isolated checkout of that exact head plus this fixture-only diff.
composition_verification.details: The composed delivery passed 55 tests: 52 legacy authoritative readback tests and 3 focused read-surface mutation-boundary tests. The task branch by itself intentionally does not provide the sibling production port.
